name: 2factor.app
description: Adds a second authentication factor by delegating verification to the external 2factor.app SaaS.
project_description:
A website is available worldwide. Due to a lack of security (server, updates, passwords), websites are attacked and hacked every day. Such an attack means a huge damage to the image of a company / website.

 That is exactly why we launched 2factor.app . Using WebAuthn's location, we enable a secure login.

 The following technologies are supported

- Windows hello

- Android fingerprint / face recognition

- MacBook fingerprint

- iOS (iPhone) fingerprint / face recognition

- Ubekey

 We recommend to install this module with composer.

We also need this QRCode library > composer require endroid/qr-code
